arStrings.szText:
Cast Skills grant a bonus based on their element:
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Immobilizes enemies for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0" * Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} |4seconds:second;
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Shock{/c} grants {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 1" * Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} bonus Movement Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds
{icon:bullet}{c_important}Frost{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 3 * Affix_Value_1"|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"]{/c} seconds

If you've dealt damage with each element in the last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 5"]{/c} seconds, Skills grant all bonuses regardless of their element.
Gain bonuses based on the element of the Cast Skill.
